name: Best of Warner Bros. 50 Cartoon Collection: Looney Tunes (2020)
original_name: Best of Warner Bros. 50 Cartoon Collection: Looney Tunes (2020)
overview: Best of Warner Bros. 50 Cartoon Collection: Looney Tunes is a two-disc DVD anthology serving as a greatest-hits compilation of Warner Bros.' golden age of animation. The set packs 50 classic theatrical shorts spanning 1936 to 1961, featuring iconic characters like Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, and Foghorn Leghorn. Rather than new restorations, it repurposes digital transfers originally created for the Golden Collection and Super Stars DVD lines, and includes essential titles like What's Opera, Doc?, Duck Amuck, and One Froggy Evening.
